case_title: Core Router LAN Gateway Interface Administratively Disabled
problem: Workstations across Finance Subnet cannot forward frames to remote enterprise subnets. Local ARP resolves switch, but gateway 192.168.1.1 is silent.

evidence.evidence_section:
Router# show ip interface brief
GigabitEthernet0/0/0   192.168.1.1     YES manual administratively down down
GigabitEthernet0/0/1   10.0.0.1        YES manual up                    up

Router# show interfaces GigabitEthernet0/0/0
GigabitEthernet0/0/0 is administratively down, line protocol is down
evidence.raw_log:
Router# show ip interface brief
GigabitEthernet0/0/0   192.168.1.1     YES manual administratively down down
